theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 16 群

items.colloc: demonstrate the ability 展示能力 | demonstrate a product 演示產品
items.distinct: exhibit 陳列；展示 | illustrate 說明；圖解
ex: The manager will demonstrate the new software.
經理將會演示這套新軟體。
This report demonstrates our commitment to quality.
這份報告證明了我們對品質的承諾。
Please demonstrate how to use the device.
請示範如何使用這台設備。

items.colloc: in the direction of 朝向...的方向 | under the direction of 在...指導下
items.distinct: instruction 指示；說明書 | guidance 指導；引導
ex: The company is moving in a new direction.
公司正朝著新的方向發展。
We work under the direction of the CEO.
我們在執行長的指導下工作。
Can you give me directions to the office?
可以給我去辦公室的方向指引嗎？

items.colloc: domestic market 國內市場 | domestic flight 國內航班
items.distinct: international 國際的 | internal 內部的
ex: Domestic sales have increased significantly this year.
今年國內銷售額顯著成長。
We focus on both domestic and foreign markets.
我們同時關注國內與國外市場。
The airline handles domestic flights only.
這家航空公司僅負責國內航線。

items.colloc: employment contract 雇用合約 | full-time employment 全職工作
items.distinct: recruitment 招募 | occupation 職業
ex: The company offers long-term employment opportunities.
該公司提供長期就業機會。
She signed an employment contract yesterday.
她昨天簽署了雇用合約。
Employment rates rose after the economic recovery.
經濟復甦後就業率有所上升。

items.colloc: offer encouragement 給予鼓勵 | words of encouragement 鼓勵的話
items.distinct: support 支持 | motivation 動機；積極性
ex: Your feedback provides great encouragement to us.
您的回饋對我們是很大的鼓勵。
Management needs to offer more encouragement to staff.
管理層需要給員工更多鼓勵。
He offered words of encouragement before the presentation.
他在簡報前給予了鼓勵的話語。

items.colloc: essential part 關鍵部分 | absolutely essential 絕對必要
items.distinct: necessary 必要的 | fundamental 基礎的
ex: Good communication is essential for teamwork.
良好的溝通對團隊合作至關重要。
It is essential to finish the report today.
今天完成這份報告是必要的。
Experience is an essential requirement for this job.
經驗是這份工作的必要條件。

items.colloc: evenly distributed 平均分布 | spread evenly 均勻塗抹
items.distinct: equally 相等地 | smoothly 平順地
ex: Workload should be distributed evenly among staff.
工作量應該在員工間平均分配。
Please spread the glue evenly on the surface.
請將膠水均勻塗抹在表面。
The two teams are evenly matched today.
今天兩隊實力相當。

items.colloc: meet expectations 符合期望 | beyond expectations 超出預期
items.distinct: prospect 前景 | anticipation 預料
ex: The product failed to meet our expectations.
該產品未能達到我們的期望。
Sales exceeded our expectations this quarter.
本季銷售額超出了我們的預期。
We have high expectations for the new project.
我們對新專案抱有高度期望。

items.pos: n. 臉；表面 | v. 面對；朝向
items.colloc: face a challenge 面臨挑戰 | face to face 面對面
items.distinct: confront 對抗 | encounter 遭遇
ex: The company will face many challenges ahead.
公司未來將面臨許多挑戰。
We need to face the problem directly.
我們需要直接面對這個問題。
Their office faces the city park.
他們的辦公室面向城市公園。

items.pos: v. 集中；聚焦 | n. 焦點；重點
items.colloc: focus on 專注於 | main focus 主要焦點
items.distinct: concentrate 集中注意力 | emphasize 強調
ex: We need to focus on our core business.
我們需要專注於核心業務。
The main focus of the meeting is marketing.
會議的主要焦點是行銷。
Please focus your attention on the screen.
請將注意力集中在螢幕上。

items.colloc: follow instructions 遵循指示 | follow the schedule 按行程表
items.distinct: obey 服從 | track 追蹤
ex: All employees must follow safety rules.
所有員工必須遵守安全規則。
Did you follow what the client said?
你有聽懂客戶說的話嗎？
Please follow me to the conference room.
請跟我到會議室。

items.pos: n. 表格；形式 | v. 形成；組成
items.colloc: fill out a form 填寫表格 | in the form of 以...形式
items.distinct: format 格式 | shape 形狀
ex: Please fill out this registration form.
請填寫這份註冊表格。
A new committee was formed last week.
一個新的委員會上週成立了。
They sent the data in the form of a report.
他們以報告形式寄送了資料。

items.colloc: formal attire 正式服裝 | formal meeting 正式會議
items.distinct: official 官方的 | ceremonial 儀式上的
ex: The interview will be a formal event.
面試將會是一個正式場合。
You should wear formal attire for the party.
你參加派對應該穿著正式服裝。
We sent a formal letter to the client.
我們發了一封正式信函給客戶。

items.colloc: formally announced 正式宣布 | formally invited 正式邀請
items.distinct: officially 官方地 | strictly 嚴格地
ex: The merger was formally announced yesterday.
合併案已於昨天正式宣布。
We were formally invited to the ceremony.
我們收到了出席典禮的正式邀請。
The proposal will be presented formally soon.
提案很快會被正式提出。

items.colloc: economic growth 經濟成長 | job growth 就業成長
items.distinct: development 發展 | increase 增加
ex: The company experienced rapid growth last year.
公司去年經歷了快速成長。
We aim for sustainable growth in profits.
我們的目標是利潤的永續成長。
Market growth depends on consumer demand.
市場成長取決於消費者需求。

items.colloc: hardly any 幾乎沒有 | hardly ever 幾乎從不
items.distinct: hard 努力地 | barely 僅僅
ex: There is hardly any time left for changes.
幾乎沒有時間進行更改了。
I hardly know the new staff member.
我幾乎不認識那位新進員工。
Hardly anyone attended the late meeting.
幾乎沒人參加那場晚間會議。

items.pos: adj. 理想的 | n. 理想
items.colloc: ideal candidate 理想人選 | ideal location 理想位置
items.distinct: perfect 完美的 | optimal 最優的
ex: She is the ideal candidate for the job.
她是這份工作的理想人選。
This office is in an ideal location.
這間辦公室位於理想的地點。
It is not an ideal time to expand.
現在不是擴張的理想時機。

items.colloc: identify the problem 確認問題 | identify a need 發現需求
items.distinct: recognize 認出 | specify 明確說明
ex: We need to identify the cause of the error.
我們需要找出錯誤的原因。
The study helps identify new market trends.
這項研究有助於識別新的市場趨勢。
Can you identify who sent this email?
你可以確認是誰寄了這封郵件嗎？

items.colloc: first impression 第一印象 | make a good impression 給人好印象
items.distinct: expression 表情；表達 | pressure 壓力
ex: She made a very good impression at the interview.
她在面試中給人很好的印象。
My first impression of the team is positive.
我對團隊的第一印象很正面。
The presentation left a strong impression on me.
那場簡報給我留下了深刻印象。

items.colloc: increasing demand 需求增加 | increasing number 數量增加
items.distinct: growing 成長中的 | rising 上升的
ex: There is an increasing demand for online services.
對線上服務的需求正在增加。
We face an increasing number of complaints.
我們面臨越來越多的投訴。
Increasing competition requires better strategies.
日益激烈的競爭需要更好的策略。
